item.title: Selangor stops issuing pig farming licenses, existing farms to be closed in stages
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Selangor State Government has decided to stop issuing new pig farming licenses throughout the state with immediate effect, in line with the latest decree of the Sultan of Selangor, Sultan Sharafuddin Idris Shah. item.title: How TNB Kept the Lights On During the Gas Supply Disruption
item.description: On 1 April 2025, a fire at a major gas pipeline near Putra Heights disrupted gas supply to several power stations in central and northern Malaysia. Since many power plants use gas to generate electricity, this incident posed a serious risk to the country’s power supply. Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) responded quickly and in a coordinated way to make sure homes, businesses and essential services continued to receive electricity.
